name: Playful Duck Chair Burger Fishing
image_vibe: bright whimsical studio, saturated playful surrealism
image_purpose: commercial fashion and food-themed concept campaign

prompt.project_info: Create a vibrant studio portrait with a playful food prop and an oversized duck-shaped chair.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional woman seated comfortably on a glossy yellow duck-shaped chair, wearing a bright pink T-shirt, light blue jeans, white socks, and pink-yellow slides; she holds a fishing rod and reaches toward a cheeseburger prop suspended safely above her.
prompt.composition_elements: Solid teal background, full-body seated composition, duck chair and burger as graphic focal points, clean commercial styling.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft even studio light, minimal shadows, high saturation, crisp cheerful pop-art mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-sharp 4K commercial photography, realistic food, fabric, chair gloss, hands, and rod, no brand logos or text.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Vibrant commercial studio portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman seated comfortably on a glossy yellow duck-shaped chair, bright pink T-shirt, light blue jeans, white socks, pink-yellow slides, holding a fishing rod with a cheeseburger prop safely suspended above and reaching toward it playfully, solid teal background, soft even lighting, saturated whimsical pop-art realism, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, unsafe prop contact, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, real food brand logo, watermark, text, distorted hands, low resolution
